Package simsgame.engine

Class GameEngine

java.lang.Object
simsgame.engine.GameEngine
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameContext
public class GameEngine extends Object implements GameContext
GameEngine handles: - Simulation state - Time progression - Global updates - Activity execution It does NOT handle UI.
